cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James' CEO describes the firm as offering the largest addressable market across its affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to RIA custody, and notes advisors are coming from wires, regionals, and other independents; the value proposition of cultural fit, platform, and multiple affiliation options appeals to advisors from many firms.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market across our affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to the RIA custody, and we have critical mass and decades of experience in all of them... Advisors are coming from, you know, wires, regionals, other independents. And again, that value proposition... the cultural fit, the platform that I talked about, the multiple affiliation options, it's appealing to advisors from a lot of different firms.

items.text: The firm describes its differentiated value proposition as advisors not having to choose between culture and capabilities, offering a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture with leading technology, products, and solutions.
items.quote: advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture along with the leading technology, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

items.text: The firm states it does not lead with the highest check but leads with culture and capabilities, maintaining a differentiated value proposition and remaining disciplined on transition assistance and economics.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics... but we lead with culture and capabilities. And so we have a true differentiated value proposition. In the absence of a true differentiated value proposition, the highest check is all you have.

items.text: The firm describes its 'best-of-both-worlds' value proposition, combining an advisor- and client-focused culture with leading technology and solutions, and cites its strong balance sheet and commitment to independence as a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.
items.quote: Our best-of-both-worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options. Additionally, our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: The CEO states the firm has the largest total addressable market by having all affiliation options at scale, so advisors moving do not have to consider whether Raymond James offers a channel but only whether they are a cultural fit.
items.quote: We have the largest total addressable market based on having all of the affiliation options at scale, and when advisors are thinking about making a move, they don't have to select. They don't have to think about whether or not Raymond James offers a channel... they can really just understand whether or not we're a good fit for them culturally in terms of the capabilities that we offer.

items.text: The firm states it has the largest addressable market because it has all affiliation options an advisor could want, and it is agnostic to how advisors affiliate, wanting them to embrace its culture, values, platform, and capabilities.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market in the industry because we have all the affiliation options that an adviser could possibly want. And we have adviser choice where we're agnostic into how you affiliate with Raymond James. We want you to fall in love with our culture, values and the platform and capabilities.

items.text: The firm's recruiting pages describe the AdvisorChoice platform as offering advisors the ability to match professional goals to the affiliation option that is right for them, each backed by a leading independent financial firm.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility – and all backed by the full support of a leading independent financial firm.
